desc:
Create them. Build them a home. Live their lives.

Residents is a roleplay and life simulator where you look after a whole household.

Make residents from toddler to elder with hundreds of outfits and 17 traits. Build your dream home room by room, or move into a ready-made house. Keep their needs up, learn skills, start a career and adopt a pet.

Explore Willow Lane and Coral Cove, from the beach to the Saturday fair. Expect kitchen fires, surprise visitors, birthdays and the odd friendly ghost.

Meet other players' residents and visit each other's homes.
